subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should all discovery-capable providers treat context limits captured in `discoveredEntries` as authoritative over final catalog and bundled static metadata, while retaining the existing explicit configured-context override path?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but it establishes a shared precedence contract at the lifecycle catalog boundary rather than a GitHub-Copilot-only repair; repository policy treats provider routing and fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve shared discovery precedence
options.body: Merge the PR with provider-discovered limits authoritative and final/static rows limited to filling missing model aliases or offline metadata.

options.title: Scope authority by provider contract
options.body: Require a provider-level capability or explicit contract before discovered context limits can outrank final catalog metadata.

options.title: Retain final catalog precedence
options.body: Do not merge this shared rule and instead pursue a narrower provider-owned correction for the affected Copilot route.

recommendation.title: Approve shared discovery precedence
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with provider-discovered limits authoritative and final/static rows limited to filling missing model aliases or offline metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged lifecycle refactor established the prepared catalog ownership and its cross-provider generation contract.
